meta: Create a resume step by step
intro: Your resume, a few short steps away.
name: Full name
title: Target position
review: Check your information, dates and spelling. You can complete missing fields in the editor.
replace: Replace the guest resume stored in this browser? You can undo this in the editor.
aiDescription: Turn your answers into a professional summary and clear job descriptions without inventing facts. A successful generation uses one credit.
aiConsent: I agree to send the information I enter to {provider} to generate a draft. The provider’s data processing terms apply.
aiUnavailable: AI assistance is not enabled yet. You can continue manually.
aiSignIn: Sign in with a verified account to use AI.
aiReview: Your draft is ready. AI can make mistakes; review and correct the information.

aiErrors.allowance: The generation limit has been reached. You can continue using the free wizard.
aiErrors.failed: Draft generation failed; no generation was used. You can try again.
aiErrors.invalid: Check your information and consent checkbox.
aiErrors.unverified: Sign in with a verified account.
aiErrors.provider_auth: The AI provider denied access. Check the API key and permissions. No credit was used.
aiErrors.provider_limit: The AI provider quota or rate limit was reached. Try again later. No credit was used.
aiErrors.provider_model: The configured AI model or endpoint was not found. No credit was used.
aiErrors.provider_request: The AI provider rejected the request format. Check the integration settings. No credit was used.

questions.5: Your resume is ready for the editor.

hints.0: Enter your name and target role. You can fill in the other fields later.
hints.1: Start with your most recent role. No experience yet? Just continue.
hints.2: Add your most recent school, or skip this step.
hints.3: Add the tools, skills and languages you know.
hints.4: Choose a template and resume language. Optionally let AI polish your answers.
hints.5: Review your details. Everything remains editable in the editor.

atsHint: These templates use readable text and a single column for ATS parsing.
